title: TeleHealth PNG – Final Year Project
summary: A 2026 web-based teleconsultation and appointment management system for the Milne Bay Provincial Health Authority.
description: TeleHealth PNG serves patients, doctors, and administrators at the Milne Bay Provincial Health Authority. The public homepage screenshot on this page is the marketing view. It does not contain patient records.
main_image_alt: Public homepage of the MBPHA TeleHealth consultation website
features: Developed and deployed a web-based teleconsultation and appointment management system for the Milne Bay Provincial Health Authority, serving patients, doctors and administrators.
Designed and implemented a MySQL database to manage structured patient, doctor, appointment and consultation information.
Implemented role-based authentication and access controls to support secure handling of health-related information.
Built doctor availability scheduling, an administrator-approved booking workflow, browser-based video consultations and digital prescriptions with PDF export.
Prepared eight formal systems analysis and design documents covering requirements, business rules, process flows, database design and interface wireframes.
Planned delivery across ten Agile sprints.
Used Git and GitHub for version control and deployed the system live on DigitalOcean.
